same_law.key_value: lesser of 5% + CPI or 10% per 12 months
same_law.reason: Both cards state Cal. Civ. Code § 1947.12, the statewide rent cap enacted by AB 1482 (Tenant Protection Act of 2019). r-0013 cites the bill alongside the code section. The LA-specific yearly maximums on r-0013 are local applications of the same formula, so the merged card keeps the statewide figure.
